title: Workshop Overview & Master Schedule
content: The hands-on 'Agentic AI Systems in Production Workshop' is scheduled for Friday next week from 09:00 AM to 05:30 PM. 45 developers and engineers are registered. Event lead is Alex Vance, technical curriculum lead is Dr. Maya Lin. Key milestones: Final catering confirmation due 3 days before; AV check due 48 hours before; attendee email due 5 days before.

title: Venue Specifications & AV Equipment Checklist
content: Location: Innovation Tech Center, Auditorium Room 302. Equipment requirements: Dual 4K laser projectors with HDMI and USB-C adapters, 2 wireless lavalier clip-on microphones for presenters, 1 handheld wireless microphone for audience Q&A, 50 grounded AC power strips along attendee desks. Dedicated Wi-Fi network: 'InnovationHub-5G' (WPA2 Passcode: AIWorkshop2026!). Full technical AV dry run must be completed at least 48 hours prior to workshop day.

title: Catering Service & Dietary Restrictions Specs
content: Catering provider: GreenLeaf Artisanal Kitchen (contact: orders@greenleafkitchen.com, tel: 555-0192). Schedule: Light continental breakfast & specialty coffee at 8:15 AM, hot gourmet buffet lunch at 12:30 PM, afternoon energy snack & cold brew at 3:30 PM. Headcount: 45 attendees plus 5 staff (50 total). Strict dietary restrictions: 8 Vegetarian, 4 Strict Vegan (must be clearly labeled and boxed), 3 Gluten-Free, and 1 Severe Airborne Peanut Allergy (venue kitchen must adhere strictly to nut-free preparation protocol). Caterer contract requires final headcount sign-off 3 business days before event.

title: Guest Speakers & Curriculum Deliverables
content: Keynote and session speakers: Dr. Aris Thorne (Foundations of Multi-Agent Orchestration), Maya Lin (Fine-Tuning & Local LLMs), Dev Patel (Agentic Tool-Calling & Memory Stores). Slide submission guideline: All slide presentations must be 16:9 ratio, exported to both PDF and PPTX formats, submitted at least 4 days before the event for review and AV compatibility check. Hands-on GitHub repo 'ai-agentic-workshop-2026' must have Docker container images and DevContainer tested on Windows, Mac, and Linux.

title: Attendee Welcome Kits & Badges
content: Each attendee receives a personalized welcome kit: 1 NFC smart name badge with branded lanyard, 1 spiral-bound reference architecture cheat-sheet workbook, and 1 high-speed 64GB USB drive preloaded with offline Ollama model weights (Llama 3.2, all-MiniLM) and starter repos. Badge printing batch must be submitted to PrintPro Express 3 days prior, and physical kit assembly completed 24 hours before workshop.

title: Participant Communications & Pre-Event Checklist
content: Communication schedule: T-5 days: Send tech prerequisite email (Python 3.11+, Docker Desktop, Git, VS Code installation instructions). T-24 hours: Send logistics email with building access QR codes, parking map, Room 302 directions, and schedule. T+2 hours post-event: Trigger anonymous satisfaction survey and issue digital completion certificates.

title: Budget Tracking & Expense Approvals
content: Approved budget code: MKT-WKSHP-2026. Total ceiling: $6,500. Catering allocated: $2,200. Venue AV hire: $1,800. Materials & kits: $1,500. Speaker honorariums & travel: $1,000. All receipts and signed purchase orders must be uploaded to the finance portal within 5 days of expense generation.
